name: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis
description: Hourly global atmospheric reanalysis combining physics-based numerical weather prediction with global observations.

name: WeatherBench 2
description: Google Research benchmark for evaluating physics and ML weather forecasting systems.

name: MIT SEVIR (Storm EVent ImagRy)
description: Temporally and spatially aligned weather event imagery with radar VIL, satellite infrared, and lightning flashes.

name: WeatherBench Historical Analogue Archive
description: Decadal historical ERA5 data for statistical analogues and data-driven seasonal weather patterns.

name: Yahoo Finance Market Data
description: Historical equity prices, intraday volume, drawdown depth, moving averages, and annualized volatility metrics.

name: SEC EDGAR Financial Filings
description: Audited corporate balance sheets, 10-K / 10-Q annual/quarterly reports, revenue, debt, and cash flow health.

name: FRED & World Bank Macroeconomics
description: Macroeconomic sovereign rates, central bank repo rates, CPI inflation, GDP forecasts, and bond spreads.

name: FHWA National Bridge Inventory (NBI)
description: Comprehensive structural database of bridge spans, superstructures, substructure pier conditions, and scour critical ratings.

name: FHWA Bridge Replacement Unit Costs (2025)
description: National replacement cost benchmarks per square meter with substructure, deck, and approach contingency models.

name: USGS National Hydrography
description: Surface water boundaries, perennial stream flows, 100-year flood elevations, and riparian conservation buffer zones.

name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
description: High-resolution digital elevation models (DEM), bank slope angle calculations, and cut-and-fill terrain difficulty.

name: NASA Earthdata Global Observations
description: Multispectral satellite environmental observations, Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), and canopy fraction.

name: NREL National Solar Radiation Database
description: Solar radiation irradiance maps, Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI), Direct Normal Irradiance (DNI), and seasonal derating.

name: US Energy Information Administration (EIA)
description: Grid electricity wholesale tariffs, substation headroom capacity, transmission interconnection metrics, and curtailment risks.

name: FAOSTAT & USDA Agricultural Statistics
description: Regional crop yield benchmarks, soil moisture-temperature matrices, drought-tolerance profiles, and water deficit limits.

name: Caltrans PeMS & METR-LA Highway Traffic
description: Inductive loop highway speed sensors, volume-to-capacity bottleneck ratios, and peak morning congestion probabilities.
